items.html: When the vessel of this king called Da'at broke, then the Da'at of the upper Aba and Ima also descended below, into the place of the Guf of Aba and Ima. But the vessel of this king called Da'at, after it broke, descended to the world of Beria, as will be explained, with God's help. The remaining six lights that were with it entered the vessel of the king called Hesed, and at that time the upper Aba and Ima were still face to face, since they do not return to back to back until everything finishes descending, for they are attached face to face, and this attachment must be entirely removed before they return to back to back. But as long as some attachment still remains in them, they do not return to back to back. Further on, with God's help, we shall explain the matter of the complete attachment of Aba and Ima while they are face to face, what it means. Now, when the general Hassadim and general Gevurot descended from the head of the upper Aba and Ima down into the body, it necessarily caused a deficiency of light, even though they did not return completely to back to back. This deficiency is the deficiency of the looking of the eyes of Aba and Ima at one another.
